title: Transport of a canonical adjunction square through presentations
statement: Let A,B,C,D be categories. Let F:A→B, S,S′:B→D, T,T′:A→C and G,V:C→D have adjunctions a,s,s′,t,t′,g,v with right adjoints R, RX, RX, RY, RY, U, U′ respectively. Supply right isomorphisms d:U⋙RY≅RX⋙R and e:U≅U′. Let δ=(e⁻¹ whiskered by RY) followed by d. Let q be left-adjoint uniqueness for a.comp s transported across d⁻¹ and t.comp g, let ν be the analogous uniqueness map for a.comp s′ transported across δ⁻¹ and t′.comp v, let αx:s≅s′ and αy:t≅t′ be canonical left-adjoint uniqueness, and let β:g≅v be uniqueness after right transport by e. Then for every M in A, q_M followed by G(αy_M) and β_(T′M) equals αx_(FM) followed by ν_M.

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Apply the Hom equivalence for a.comp s. Left-adjoint uniqueness transfers the second transpose to a.comp s′ and its unit. Naturality of d moves it past the geometric comparison in the first transpose. Naturality of the geometric unit moves the scalar uniqueness map; the scalar unit transfers to t′ by uniqueness. The defining unit equation of β transfers the remaining geometric unit through e. The result is the same composite unit followed by δ, so injectivity proves equality.

lean.statement:
theorem adjunctionSquareTransport
    {A B C D : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
    {F : A ⥤ B} {R : B ⥤ A} {S S' : B ⥤ D} {RX : D ⥤ B}
    {T T' : A ⥤ C} {RY : C ⥤ A} {G V : C ⥤ D} {U U' : D ⥤ C}
    (a : F ⊣ R) (s : S ⊣ RX) (s' : S' ⊣ RX) (t : T ⊣ RY) (t' : T' ⊣ RY)
    (g : G ⊣ U) (v : V ⊣ U') (d : U ⋙ RY ≅ RX ⋙ R) (e : U ≅ U') (M : A) :
    let δ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight e.symm RY ≪≫ d
    let q := ((a.comp s).ofNatIsoRight d.symm).leftAdjointUniq (t.comp g)
    let ν := ((a.comp s').ofNatIsoRight δ.symm).leftAdjointUniq (t'.comp v)
    let αx := s.leftAdjointUniq s'
    let αy := t.leftAdjointUniq t'
    let β := (g.ofNatIsoRight e).leftAdjointUniq v
    q.hom.app M ≫ G.map (αy.hom.app M) ≫ β.hom.app (T'.obj M) =
      αx.hom.app (F.obj M) ≫ ν.hom.app M
